channel.title: Pinwei — discover agent skills with taste
channel.description: A daily-restocked shelf of agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents — each one with what it actually does, who it is for, and the one-line install command. Skills are picked by hand from public repositories; the shelf favours the ones that are fun or genuinely useful over the ones that merely exist.
